title: Soil and Litter GitHub Issues Tracker
text:
I completed several updates to the soil and litter validation database, which included incorporating temporal and spatiotemporal data (#466, #468), refactoring unit conversions (#463), and updating workflow documentation (#454). Regarding input data and calibration, I updated the Maliau change log to reflect enhanced soil microbial definitions (#456) and resolved a netCDF conversion transpose bug that affected the soil and litter carbon-nitrogen-phosphorus ratio troubleshooting (#464, addressing #455). My immediate focus is to complete the first pass of the soil and litter validation pipeline. Additionally, I will continue coordinating on satellite EVI data selection for the SAFE project area (#452) and structuring a weighted sum of errors for model calibration (#428).
